description: This PHP source file defines the class ImapHandlerFakeData, which acts as a fake handler for IMAP interactions primarily used for testing purposes. It provides mechanisms to mock responses, track calls, and handle simulated IMAP command results.

classes.name: ImapHandlerFakeData
classes.description: A test utility class that simulates IMAP handler responses for testing other parts of the application without connecting to a real IMAP server.

methods.name: encodeArgs
methods.description: Encodes arguments into an md5 hash to use as a key.

methods.description: Retrieves the next predetermined return value for a specific call with encoded arguments.

methods.name: getCall
methods.description: Retrieves the fake call result based on the method name and arguments, throwing exceptions if no match is found.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Public method to invoke a fake call, returning the mocked response.

methods.description: Adds a fake call response for a specific method and arguments.

methods.description: Sets or resets a fake call to a specific state.

methods.description: Bulk method to initialize multiple fake call responses for testing.
